name: incredibox-composer
description: Incredibox (Steam) 自动化作曲工作台：Host UI + CDP Bridge + 注入式 Guest 运行时

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p packages/guest --noEmit && tsc -p packages/bridge --noEmit && tsc -p packages/host --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build:guest && npm run build:host
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
